name: Cahya Mata Sarawak Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司没有公告涉及业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，也没有公布新的合约。已发布的公告主要为季度和年度业绩、股东大会、股份分拆上市、股息除权、涉及Dato Sri Mahmud Abu Bekir Taib的诉讼以及董事会委员会成员变动。
overview_en: In 2026, the company announced no expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of any business segment, and no new contracts. The announcements issued were mainly quarterly and annual results, general meetings, additional listing/subdivision of shares, dividend ex-date, litigation involving Dato Sri Mahmud Abu Bekir Taib, and changes in board committee memberships.
